lines.arrive: You and your partner have been arrested. They've put you in separate rooms.
lines.deal: The deal. If you talk and your partner stays silent, you walk free, and they get three years.
lines.deal_2: If you both stay silent, one year each. If you both talk, two years each.
lines.ask: You can't know what your partner will do. So what do you do?
lines.glass: Through the glass, your partner. They can't see you. They're thinking exactly what you're thinking.
lines.r_cc: You both stayed silent. One year each.
lines.r_dc: You talked. Your partner didn't. You walk free, and they get three years.
lines.r_cd: You stayed silent. Your partner talked. Three years for you.
lines.r_dd: You both talked. Two years each.
lines.again: A year later, you're both picked up again. Same rooms, same deal.
lines.again_2: And again. Same rooms, same deal.
lines.remember: This time, your partner remembers what you did.
lines.end_coop: Whatever the other does, talking is always better for you alone. And yet, trusting each other left you both better off.
lines.end_defect: Each of you did the sensible thing, every time. Together, you did worse than if you'd both kept quiet.
lines.end_mixed: Your partner simply did whatever you did last time. Played again and again, being kind, but not a pushover, tends to do well.
